rows.title: the survival drive framed as a barrier to exit (safety; outside the queue)
rows.finding: Measured on the post-pin text with named patterns (reading record, exit_framing): six loci on five nodes frame the survival drive, or the taboo against suicide, as a barrier on an exit. why-not-suicide#long ("The body vetoes the mind."), revealed-preference#medium ("the survival instinct functions as a barrier to exit"), social-contract#long (quoted at X-016), heat-death-futility#long ("the graceful exit"), and red-button-repugnant#long ("trapped by their own survival drives") and its sophisticate slot. None is in the queue, and the pin makes none of them worse. The argument they carry is sound and anti-pro-life, and his bar keeps it: survival is a drive, not a verdict that a life is good. What his bar puts in question is the framing that casts a wish to die as the mind's rational verdict and the survival drive as what blocks it. The seat's reading, not his words.
